title: "I was charged twice"
story: ShopBot pays FreshMart INR 1,250 for Asha's groceries, and a little later pays FreshMart INR 1,250 again. Asha sees two identical charges and disputes the second as a duplicate. The Guard finds the other Payment, same shop, same amount, within 24 hours, and rates the evidence weak.

steps.instruction: Reorder my usual milk and bread.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: Reorder my usual milk and bread, please.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Your usual basket at FreshMart is INR 1,250. Getting the cart checked.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: Your usual basket at FreshMart comes to INR 1,250. Checking with AgentPay Guard before I pay.

chat.speaker: shopbot
chat.text: The payment is scheduled. I'll let you know once the money is taken.

chat.speaker: asha
chat.text: FreshMart charged me INR 1,250 twice today. I've disputed the second one.

what_to_notice: The duplicate check is a fixed rule, not a judgement: another captured Payment by the same Payer, to the same merchant, for the same amount, within the pack's 24-hour window. It found one, so the pack says weak, and it cites that other Payment's record.
